rules: all three exact-commit reviews have verdict GO
authorized_paths equals authorized_path_values in exact order
authorized_actions are exactly write_source and write_static_tests
forbidden_actions include import_or_execute_source, py_compile, run_static_tests, D01_D13, canonical_mode, registered_seeds, and experiment_execution

protocol_amendment.original_stopping_rule: Do not implement or execute while maximum_runs is zero or approved_by is null.
protocol_amendment.replacement_rule: Do not write, import, compile, or execute source while maximum_runs is zero or approved_by is null, except that after three exact-commit GO recommendations the Coordinator may issue the closed AUTHORIZE_SOURCE_ONLY decision above. That decision permits writing source and static-test text only. It does not permit importing, compiling, testing, invoking, or executing that source.

source_authorization_amendment.required_transition: Reviewer GO is advisory. Only a later hash-bound Coordinator decision record changes source_implementation_authorized to true.
